hero.title: Visit Palma with us: Discover our Guided Tours in French
hero.subtitle: 🌴 Hello everyone! My name is Rony, I've been living in Majorca for over 10 years — and I never get tired of it! Originally from Vendée, I fell in love with Palma, its gastronomy, its history and its charming little streets. It's to share this passion that I created several guided tours to discover Palma differently:
